Dialogs.Dialog: Oh, ▲小早川＊▲. You look sleepy.
Kobayakawa
Yeah... It's still outside my operating hours.
Up late again？
A little. I bought a new game and had a hard time beating the boss. Next thing I knew, it was light out.
...That's way more than a little.
Still, isn't this better than seeing me grumpy over a boss？ Thanks to that, I'm all smiles today.
(She might have a point...)
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲。
▲Kobayaka＊▲, what's up？
Hey. Don't you think all classes should start in the afternoon？
That's out of nowhere. What about the morning？
Free time. You want to take it easy in the morning, right？ I'm sure everyone would be on board.
Wouldn't that mean having classes until night, though？
...Never mind, then. I want to take it easy at night, too.
(Sounds like she always wants to take it easy.)
(Huh？ ▲小早川＊▲...)
Kobayakawa
Hah...
▲小早川＊▲. What's wrong？ You look gloomy.
Someone as carefree as you wouldn't understand.
...Is it really that serious？
Yeah. The teacher chewed me out for being late so much. Sigh...
(...That's serious？)
Oh, ▲小早川＊▲.
Kobayakawa
Sigh... We have P.E. in the morning... Give me a break. My body isn't even awake yet.
Yeah, it'd be better if it were in the afternoon.
In the afternoon, you just get sleepy after eating lunch, though.
Then when would be good？
Hmm... Whenever I feel like it, maybe？
(I doubt she'll ever feel like it.)
Kobayakawa
▲小早川＊▲!？ Sorry, did I bump into you？
...No. Sore muscles.
Sore muscles？ From what？
We did squats in P.E., and... I kind of got carried away. See you...
(▲小早川＊▲ getting carried away doing squats...)
Kobayakawa
Oh, hey. I saw green juice at the school store earlier. What's the deal with that？
What do you mean？ Maybe someone requested it？
...That stuff doesn't taste like anything a high schooler should be drinking.
You've tried it before？
Yeah, and I'm not a bug, you know. It's just bitter.
(Putting it like that makes me never want to try it...)
(▲小早川＊▲... Is she heading to the library？)
Hey, heading to the library？ At this hour？
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. Yeah, I left something behind.
I see. Want me to come with you？
Why？
Why...? No real reason.
Then I'm good. No thanks.
▲小早川＊▲. What're you doing here？
Kobayakawa
Training. If some bad guy shows up... Wham.
Come on, don't do anything dangerous.
...I'm kidding, obviously. Why take it so seriously？
Knowing you, ▲小早川＊▲, I figured you just might.
...See？ Because you always do stuff like that.
I only do it to you. Call it showing affection.
(...Is it really？)
Kobayakawa
Oh, come on... I was looking for you.
Need something？
Forget it. I got asked to move class materials and wanted help, but I gave up.
You gave up...? Are you sure that's okay？
School PA
First-year Rinko Kobayakawa, please come to the staff room immediately.
Ugh, the worst...
▲小早川＊▲, what were you doing by yourself？
Kobayakawa
Observing the commoners.
What's that supposed to mean？
Looking down from the roof, people look like ants. It's pretty amusing.
(Guess she's usually the one being looked down on...)
You look like you want to say something... What？
...Nothing.
Kobayakawa
Huh？ What're you...
▲小早川＊▲？ ● was just wandering around and ended up here. What about you？
...Never mind.
Well, that's suspicious.
...I wanted to practice basketball so I don't look bad in P.E. ...Ugh, I didn't think anyone would see me.
(Guess she's more of a hard worker than I thought？)
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. Good timing. Hey, don't you think sneak attacks are playing dirty？
Sneak attacks？ Are we talking fighting games？
No, come on. We had a pop quiz in math class...
Ah, so you bombed it, huh？
Don't just assume that—even if you're right. Even I'd study if I knew in advance.
(...Bet she still wouldn't.)
▲小早川＊▲. ...Did you get called in？
Kobayakawa
You're not wrong, but it's not what you're thinking.
Hm？
I came to get praised today. My library newsletter book review was a hit, so they asked me to do a column.
Whoa, that's great.
Well, it's a hassle, so I'm not gonna do it. Doesn't feel bad, though.
(If ▲小早川＊▲ wrote a column, I might read it every time.)
Kobayakawa
Hehe.
▲小早川＊▲... Laughing to yourself is kinda creepy...
Ack, don't just listen in on me. We have a chemistry lab next, that's all.
Aren't you bad at science, ▲小早川＊▲？
Labs are different. They're easy, and actually pretty fun.
(Too bad that doesn't show up in her grades.)
▲小早川＊▲. In a bad mood or something？
Kobayakawa
I overslept today and missed breakfast. ...Is it lunch yet？
Why not eat your lunch early...？
I'm not doing something a guy on a sports team would do.
I don't really get that comparison, but you're hungry, right？
It's fine. It goes against my principles.
(Her principles, huh...)
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲. Looking sleepy as usual.
Kobayakawa
What do you mean, 'as usual'？ I can't help it right now. I just got hypnotized.
What's that supposed to mean？
Math class. The teacher's voice is lethal. Everyone in my class calls him 'The Hypnotist.'
Wow, that's really something.
Afternoon classes are especially dangerous. There's just no fighting it.
▲小早川＊▲？ What's wrong？ Are you sick？ Hurt？
Kobayakawa
You don't need to freak out. I was just taking a nap.
A nap...？
Yep. And seeing you woke me right up. Later!
(Don't just 'Later!' me. ...She gave me a scare.)
▲小早川＊▲. Is this your favorite spot or something？
Kobayakawa
Yeah, it's suffocating being in the classroom.
Nothing happened... right？
Nope. Don't worry about it. Want some juice？
...What ▲小早川＊▲'s drinking？
If you don't want any, that's fine.
(That's an indirect kiss... Well, whatever.)
▲小早川＊▲. What's up？ You're spacing out.
Kobayakawa
Well, once the afternoon hits, you start wishing school was over already.
Keep spacing out like that and you'll get in trouble in class.
I know, I know. Jeez, you really love lecturing me.
I'll pay attention in class. Anyway, what should I do after school today...
(Now I'm worried...)
▲小早川＊▲. What are you doing in a place like this？
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. I was just passing by, but look. Isn't the anatomy model kinda cool？
...How so？
It's just kinda punk.
I don't get that at all!
Aw, you just don't get it.
▲小早川＊▲. Reading outside again？
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. Yeah, I can't use my classroom right now.
Did something happen？
The boys came up with some dumb new game again. Stuff's flying everywhere, so I can't read in there.
Young people sure have a lot of energy.
Whatever you say, Grandpa. Seriously though, what are they, in grade school？
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲。
Hm？
Hey, listen. The school store just got some new drinks in.
New drinks？ It's probably just another kind of tea or something, right？
I heard they've got some weird ones, too. Makes you curious, right？
●'ll pass.
Well, I am. So be my guinea pig, okay？
(So ●'m the poison taster...)
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲。
▲Kobayaka＊▲, what's up？
Hey, are clubs fun？ Watching you do yours kinda got me curious.
Oh yeah？ Why not try one out for a day, then？
Let's see... Is there a gaming club or something？ Where we use club funds for the arcade.
No way that exists.
Guess I'd have to start one myself, then. What a pain...
Don't worry, it'd never get approved anyway.
Kobayakawa
Hey.
▲小早川＊▲？ What's with the long face？
Do you have any weird nicknames？
Nicknames？ Where'd that come from？
...No reason. *sigh*...
(Did someone give her a weird nickname or something？)
(Oh, there's ▲小早川＊▲...)
Kobayakawa
Why are you following me？
Wait... Are you stalking me？
Of course not. I just happened to spot you, so...
And you thought you'd come all the way to the girls' locker room with me？
What！？ Please excuse me！
▲小早川＊▲. What's up, looking to join the club？
Kobayakawa
I was just walking by when the tennis club advisor told me to clean the courts. What gives？
Ah... Mr. Suzuki must've mistaken you for a member.
Ugh, seriously？ Then you're a member—you do it instead.
Eh？
Alright, I'll leave you to it.
(Seriously...？)
Kobayakawa
Do you have any class duties？
No class duties for me. I'm already on the library committee, after all.
Right？ That's what I keep telling them, too.
Hm？
My homeroom teacher told me to take one on. Why ask someone as busy as me？
(Probably because you looked like you had free time...)
Kobayakawa
Hmm...
▲小早川＊▲？ What are you doing？
▲主人公＊▲. I saw a cat go this way and followed it, but I lost sight of it.
Oh yeah？ Why don't you try calling it？ Like, 'Meow.'
Right, good idea. Meo... As if I'd say that.
(So close...)
▲小早川＊▲. It's pretty noisy out there. Do you know what happened？
Kobayakawa
Apparently a dog wandered in earlier and stole a cutlet sandwich from the school store.
Wait, a dog got all the way inside？ Is that okay...？
It's fine. I saw it, and it was just a miniature dachshund. Apparently it belongs to a visitor.
Oh, that explains it.
Hehe, it was cute. Dogs are pretty nice, too.
(I'm thirsty...)
Waah！
Whoa！ ？
Kobayakawa
Eh？
Ah, my juice...
Sorry... I'll go get a cloth.
(That was bad timing...)
(Huh, ▲小早川＊▲...)
▲小早川＊▲。
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲。
...Were you just crying？
Oh... I'm fine. It's just from a novel I'm reading. A series called 'Lost in the Night.'
Oh, that's a relief.
It'd be embarrassing if I read it in the classroom and started crying.
▲小早川＊▲。
Kobayakawa
What？ Do you need something？
...That's cold. Are you mad about something？
I don't have much time left. If it's nothing important, talk to me later.
Wait, did something happen？ If there's anything ● can do--
Geez, stop making a fuss. I forgot my homework and have to get it done fast.
Oh, is that all... Good luck.
Kobayakawa
...Something's off.
▲小早川＊▲？ What are you muttering about？
Wah... Oh, it's you. Hey, doesn't my face look weird today？
It looks the same as usual. Cute as always.
What！？ Don't say that here！ ...I guess a guy wouldn't notice anyway.
(Is there some difference only she can tell？)
▲小早川＊▲, something on your mind？
Kobayakawa
Huh？ Oh... I heard there's a school where orange juice comes out of the faucets.
Wow, that's amazing. I'm jealous.
But I was wondering how they wash their hands... They'd get all sticky.
...Wouldn't they just use a faucet that has water？
Oh right, they'd have water too... Of course. Ah, glad we cleared that up.
(Don't tell me that's what was bothering her...)
▲小早川＊▲。
Kobayakawa
Morning. What is it？
Good morning？
Day or night, if I just woke up, it's 'good morning.' Got a problem with that？
(Guess she wakes up grumpy whether it's morning or afternoon...)
▲小早川＊▲. Did something good happen？
Kobayakawa
Oh, you want to hear？ A new book by Fumiko Mido is coming out.
...Who？
Fumiko Mido! A giant of the shojo manga world! If you don't know her work, you're missing out on 80% of life.
(Does that mean ● only enjoys the other 20% of life...)
Kobayakawa
...I'm crushed. I don't think I'll ever recover from this.
▲小早川＊▲？ What happened？ Did you get in trouble with a teacher again？
My cat-tail mechanical pencil is missing... Ugh, this is the worst.
If it stands out that much, I'm sure it'll turn up.
You think so...？ I hope you're right.
(I hope it turns up.)
Oh, hey, ▲小早川＊▲. The courtyard really feels nice, doesn't it？
Kobayakawa
Yeah. It's nice just spacing out here.
Makes you wish this could last forever.
Agreed. Except...
Sigh, there goes the bell. Gotta get back to class.
Yeah, let's hurry.
Kobayakawa
Hey, this way, this way.
▲小早川＊▲？ Class is about to start.
My class has study hall. I saw your class out here for P.E., so I snuck out for a bit.
...You're gonna get in trouble if you're caught.
It'll be fine... Oh!
▲小早川＊▲？
P.E. Teacher
Hey, you there!
Whoa...
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲, got a second？ Music class is so boring, isn't it？
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲. Well, once it's for a class, it suddenly feels like a chore.
Exactly, especially chorus. I don't want to sing songs I don't even like.
So, what are you getting at？
Next period... let's ditch.
...Obviously we can't do that.
▲小早川＊▲. So this is where you were？
Kobayakawa
...Yeah. Being here makes me remember all kinds of things.
Oh...？ All kinds of things？
Ah... No! Not THAT! Well, I mean, not NOT that, either...
Hm？
Ugh, whatever, subject dropped!
▲小早川＊▲. Reading in the courtyard？
Kobayakawa
Yeah. It's pretty nice.
Let's see what you've got...
...Don't look.
Come on, just a peek.
No 'just a peek,' no nothing. People around us are gonna think we're flirting.
(Darn it...)
Kobayakawa
Oh, did you come to check out a book too？
Hmm, I just kinda wandered in. Since I'm here, maybe you can recommend something, ▲小早川＊▲.
We don't carry dirty books.
...I know that.
Oh really？ Then I don't have anything to recommend to you.
Stop saying stuff that gives people the wrong idea...
Kobayakawa
Hey, how come humans don't have paw pads？ We could squish 'em to kill time, plus they'd be cute, right？
...I don't know about that.
Hmm... Yeah, paw pads on you wouldn't be cute at all. Actually, that's kinda creepy. Never mind then.
Right？ Though on you, ▲小早川＊▲, they might actually work？
Huh... So you're into that kinda thing？
(Don't make it sound weird...)
Huh？ Is ▲小早川＊▲ not here？
Kobayakawa
You called？
Whoa!? What are you doing under the counter？
I saw you coming and figured I'd scare you. How was it？
How was it？ Well... kinda childish, I guess.
Smack!
Kobayakawa
...Oh, good timing. Piggyback.
▲小早川＊▲... A piggyback ride？
I've been checking out books nonstop and I'm beat. So carry me back to class.
...Guess I have no choice, if you say so, ▲小早川＊▲.
...Okay, I was obviously kidding, but... hehe. Good to know you'd actually do it if I asked.
Kobayakawa
Hey, did you hear we're expanding the science section soon？
Yeah... I think they mentioned something about that.
They asked me to put a list together, but... I don't really know much about it.
Got it. I'll help you out, ●.
Yes! Nothing like having a boyfriend you can count on.
(When she's this happy about it, there's no way I couldn't help.)
Kobayakawa
Say, have you ever wanted to live in the library？
Live here？ Hmm... I don't know about that.
I'd move in permanently. It's all-you-can-read, you know？
Yeah, except you'd be on library duty every single day.
...Maybe I'll pass on moving in forever. A short stay works.
(So she still wants to stay over for a few days.)
Huh？ I thought ▲小早川＊▲ was on duty today... Skipping again？
Who said I'm skipping out？
Huh... Where are you？
Kobayakawa
Right here, under the counter.
...What are you doing down there？
What do you think？ Come on... It's the library. I'm reading a book, obviously.
(Curled up under the counter reading a book... She's like a little animal...)
You're still here？
Kobayakawa
Hey, why is the committee head so uptight about the rules？
Well, it comes with the responsibility.
Ugh. Seriously, with the braids and glasses, always going on about 'the rules, the rules'... What's with that？
Braids and glasses？ Our committee head doesn't wear braids or glasses.
Really？ That's how they look to me, anyway. Somehow.
(What kind of mental image is that？)
▲小早川＊▲. Weren't you on library duty？
Kobayakawa
Well, nobody was using the library.
Just because nobody's there doesn't mean you can skip out.
It's fine. I'll go back if someone shows up.
...And how are you supposed to know if someone shows up？
You know, library committee intuition.
(Pretty sure that's psychic powers.)
Kobayakawa
Sigh... I have to pick my book recommendations for the library newsletter by the end of the week.
Isn't that right up your alley, ▲小早川＊▲？
I'm out of ideas. Even I know the books I like aren't for everyone.
It's fun to have picks like that once in a while. You can be in charge of the niche stuff, ▲小早川＊▲.
Hmm... Well, I guess that works.
Kobayakawa
It's bad. A war between factions is about to break out on the library committee.
That's the first I've heard of it. I thought everyone got along.
It's a bloody feud between the popular fiction and literary fiction factions. If I had to pick, I lean more toward literary fiction, though...
Oh, that's what you meant by factions...
Obviously. What did you think I meant？
(So it's not a power struggle over who becomes the next committee head...)
Kobayakawa
The mystery has finally been solved. The mystery of the library.
What are you talking about？
The flowers on the checkout counter. We never knew who was arranging them all this time, right？
A teacher, right？ Isn't it？
Turns out it was the committee head's doing. Apparently it's a tradition passed down from one library committee head to the next. Like a secret art passed down to a single successor.
(Passed down to a single successor... Does that mean they teach you how to arrange flowers, too？)
Kobayakawa
Hey, it looks like the computer's acting up.
Yeah, it's been like that lately. I wish they'd get us a new one.
Apparently that's a whole ordeal. Hmm, I wonder if we can just borrow one from the staff room for now.
'Borrow'...? Oh, you mean ask them to lend us one.
Huh？ O-Oh, right. By putting in an official request, of course. Since it's an emergency and all.
(Wait... was she planning on just taking one without asking？)
Kobayakawa
Oh, good timing. They asked me to write a feature for the next library newsletter. Got any ideas？
Ideas, huh... Well, last time was a feature on light novels, and before that was...
A feature on animals.
Didn't you get in trouble for making that one way too focused on cats？
That was bound to happen the second they put me in charge of it. The readers loved it, though.
Kobayakawa
When we had the vendor come take away those old books the other day, I felt a little sad.
Yeah... Especially since we helped mend them on the committee and all.
...I hope they find new owners, though.
Let me see...
Kobayakawa
Why is it that some people just can't return books on time？
...They probably just forget. I don't think anyone means any harm by it, though.
If "not meaning any harm" let you off the hook, we wouldn't need the police.
Now you're exaggerating.
It's a new release and it's already a whole week overdue! Do they have any idea how much I've been looking forward to reading it？ Ugh...
(Whoever has it, please bring it back soon...)
Kobayakawa
The teacher just asked me to air out the books in the archives.
Wait, does that include those massive encyclopedia-looking ones？
Yep. It's your chance to show off your manly strength. Your girlfriend might fall for you all over again.
Ooh, so cool. I think I'm falling for you even more.
Sigh... Guess I don't have a choice.
Kobayakawa
Geez. You're late!
Huh？ Did we have plans or something？
I told you I wanted help sorting the new arrivals after school...
Wait... You never told me that, though？
Huh？ ...Oh, right, I meant to tell you at lunch and forgot. Hehe, sorry.
(Oh well, I guess it's fine.)
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. 'Morning.
Hey, morning. Raining today, huh.
Yeah, no kidding. Anyone can see that. What are you gonna do about this？
What do you want me to do about it...? Man, someone's grumpy.
It's the rain's fault. I don't do well with moisture.
So that's what that was...
Kobayakawa
This is the worst.
Morning... That's the first thing you say today？
Well, it's raining! I'm gonna get wet.
You have an umbrella, don't you？
Even with an umbrella, you still get wet when it rains!
(She really hates the rain, huh...)
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. 'Morning.
Morning. Raining today, huh.
Wonder if it's gonna rain all day today？
Hard to say...
Ugh. I really don't do well with rain. If I were alone, I'd just skip school.
Don't skip school over a little rain...
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. 'Morning.
Morning, ▲小早川＊▲.
Kobayakawa
Nice weather, huh. Hope it stays like this.
I'm sure it'll hold up just fine, don't you think？
Kobayakawa
Let's see, sunny today...
Hope it holds up like this.
Kobayakawa
Hehe, it cleared up.
Yeah, feels great.
Kobayakawa
Isn't it kinda cloudy out？
Just hope it doesn't rain...
Kobayakawa
Awful lot of clouds, huh？ I've got a bad feeling...
I could really do without getting caught in the rain.
Kobayakawa
Cloudy, huh. Well, I don't mind.
Might actually be more comfortable this way.
Kobayakawa
*sigh* Rain, seriously...
Come on, cheer up.
Kobayakawa
It's raining. What're you gonna do？
Don't ask ●... Come on, let's go.
Kobayakawa
Rain, huh... Well, can't be helped.
Nothing we can do about it. Come on, let's go.
Kobayakawa
Hey... I'm really looking forward to it, okay.
Hm？ To what？
...Our date, obviously! Are you making me say it on purpose？
It's not like that. Yeah, ● can't wait either.
Kobayakawa
Almost time for our date...
Oh, can't wait？
I didn't say that! My expectations are just average.
(Just average, huh...)
(▲小早川＊▲'s running late... Guess I'll wait a bit.)
Kobayakawa
Yeah...
You're late, ▲小早川＊▲.
I thought you would've gone on ahead... You're gonna be late too, you know.
I'm not gonna leave you behind. Come on, we'll make it if we hurry a bit.
Trying to act all cool. ...Well, thanks, I guess.
(Crap, I'm late...)
▲小早川＊▲！
Kobayakawa
You knew I was waiting for you, so how could you be late？
Sorry... My alarm didn't go off...
Don't give me excuses!
(...Well, it really is on ●, after all.)
Kobayakawa
Huh？ Do we need our English dictionaries today？
Don't ask ●... If you forgot yours, I can lend you mine.
Hehe, thanks. Sorry about that.
(Why can't she just ask me to lend it to her...？)
Kobayakawa
Oh! A cat just went by!
Huh...？ Where？
Sorry, I'm going after it!
Hey, don't chase after it! We're gonna be late!
Kobayakawa
Oh... Shoot.
What's wrong？ Did you forget something？
I forgot to put my new song on my player. Maybe I should go back and put it on...
You'll be late. Just tough it out for a day.
Kobayakawa
So, I brought lunch today... Want some？
Of course I do! Now, where should we eat...
Kobayakawa
I made lunch today. I got some for you too, if you want？
Really？ Where should we eat, then？
Kobayakawa
I made lunch for you today.
Oh, thanks! Where should we eat？
Wanna go to ▲飲食店＊＊＊＊＊▲ to eat？
Kobayakawa
Sure, that's fine.
How about ▲飲食店＊＊＊＊＊▲？
Kobayakawa
Sounds good to me.
Let's go with ▲飲食店＊＊＊＊＊▲.
Kobayakawa
Yup！
Kobayakawa
I didn't bring lunch today.
I see. Wanna check out the cafeteria, then？
Come to think of it, we've never gone together, huh？ Alright, let's do that.
Kobayakawa
I don't have a lunch today. What should we do？
Hmm... How about the cafeteria？ We haven't been there together yet, right？
That sounds nice. Let's do that.
Kobayakawa
I didn't bring a lunch with me today...
Wanna go to the cafeteria？ We haven't gone together yet.
Sounds good. Let's do that.
Kobayakawa
I'm in the mood for the cafeteria today.
Alright, let's do that then.
Kobayakawa
We're going to the cafeteria today.
The cafeteria, huh？ That sounds pretty good.
Kobayakawa
Hey, I wanna eat at the cafeteria today. Okay？
Yeah, sure.
Looks delicious. Time to dig in!
Kobayakawa
Let's eat.
Kobayakawa
Hmm... That was alright.
I thought ● was pretty good, though.
Hmph. Guess you don't need my lunches anymore, then.
No, I still need those.
Oh, really. Guess I have no choice.
Kobayakawa
Thank you for the meal!
Thanks for the food. That was really good!
Better than my lunches？
Not as good as your lunches, ▲小早川＊▲!
Yeah, yeah, nice save. I'll make you lunch again.
Kobayakawa
Phew, I might've eaten a bit too much.
You shouldn't overdo it. You're gonna get sleepy.
I'm getting sleepy now... Can I take a nap here？
Right after I warned you. You can't sleep here!
That was a mistake...
Rain, huh...
Glad I brought an umbrella.
I don't have an umbrella... What should I do？
I hate getting soaked. Glad I brought it.
